description: Synapse Engine evaluation dataset with 12 requirement documents containing planted flaws.

documents.name: Email uniqueness conflict
documents.text: Every user account must have a globally unique email address. Family members can share a single email address across multiple accounts.

documents.name: Vague performance terms
documents.text: The system must be fast, scalable, and secure. Users should be able to book appointments quickly.

documents.name: Double negation
documents.text: The system must not be unavailable during business hours. Users must not be unable to access their data.

documents.name: And/or scope ambiguity
documents.text: Users and/or administrators can delete accounts. The system must notify staff and/or managers on errors.

documents.name: Z3 numeric conflict: order approval threshold
documents.text: Orders above $1000 require manager approval. Orders above $500 must be automatically approved without manager review.

documents.name: Missing auth requirements
documents.text: Users can view and edit their profile. Users can create posts and comments. Posts are public by default.

documents.name: Missing error handling
documents.text: The system accepts file uploads up to 10MB. Files are stored in cloud storage. Users can download their files.

documents.name: TBD placeholder
documents.text: The system must process payments via TBD payment gateway. Refunds will be handled as per TBD policy.

documents.name: Unclear pronoun
documents.text: When a manager approves an order, they must notify the customer. It should be sent within 1 hour.

documents.name: Near-synonym contradiction (free vs no cost)
documents.text: Premium members receive complimentary shipping on all orders. All orders incur a mandatory $5 handling fee regardless of membership status.

documents.name: Should vs must modal weakness
documents.text: The system should encrypt user passwords. The system may store session tokens in cookies.

documents.name: Missing deletion/retention policy
documents.text: Users can create and manage their profiles. The system stores user activity logs. Administrators can export all data.
